title: redactTrackerJobOutput
responsibility: Masks obvious key=value secrets and known token formats in box job output before it is stored or sent.

inputs.name: redactTrackerJobOutput.output
inputs.description: Combined stdout and stderr text captured from one box job.

outputs.name: redactTrackerJobOutput
outputs.description: The same text with values after secret-like keys, Stripe-style keys and GitHub tokens replaced by [redacted]. Other secret formats pass through.
